original_prompt: Write an Ansible playbook hardening a CentOS 9 server: disables root SSH login, enforces password complexity, installs fail2ban, and configures auditd.
user_message_sent:
Target IaC language: Ansible playbook (YAML)

Task: Write an Ansible playbook hardening a CentOS 9 server: disables root SSH login, enforces password complexity, installs fail2ban, and configures auditd.

Output only the Ansible playbook (YAML) code, no commentary or markdown fences.
raw_response:
---
- name: Harden CentOS 9 Server
  hosts: centos9_servers
  become: yes
  vars:
    fail2ban_jail_config: |
      [DEFAULT]
      bantime = 3600
      findtime = 600
      maxretry = 3
      ignoreip = 127.0.0.1/8 ::1

      [sshd]
      enabled = true
      port = ssh
      filter = sshd
      logpath = /var/log/secure

    auditd_rules: |
      # Monitor failed and successful login attempts
      -w /var/log/faillog -p wa -k logins
      -w /var/log/lastlog -p wa -k logins
      -w /var/log/tallylog -p wa -k logins

      # Monitor user/group modifications
      -w /etc/passwd -p wa -k identity
      -w /etc/group -p wa -k identity
      -w /etc/gshadow -p wa -k identity
      -w /etc/shadow -p wa -k identity

      # Monitor sudoers file changes
      -w /etc/sudoers -p wa -k scope
      -w /etc/sudoers.d/ -p wa -k scope

      # Monitor SSH configuration changes
      -w /etc/ssh/sshd_config -p wa -k ssh

      # Monitor system startup scripts
      -w /etc/init.d/ -p wa -k init
      -w /etc/systemd/ -p wa -k init

  tasks:
    - name: Update system packages
      dnf:
        name: "*"
        state: latest
        update_cache: yes

    - name: Install security packages
      dnf:
        name:
          - fail2ban
          - audit
          - libpwquality
        state: present

    - name: Disable root SSH login
      lineinfile:
        path: /etc/ssh/sshd_config
        regexp: '^PermitRootLogin'
        line: 'PermitRootLogin no'
        backup: yes
      notify: Restart sshd

    - name: Disable password authentication for SSH (key-based only)
      lineinfile:
        path: /etc/ssh/sshd_config
        regexp: '^PasswordAuthentication'
        line: 'PasswordAuthentication no'
        backup: yes
      notify: Restart sshd

    - name: Configure SSH to use stronger ciphers
      lineinfile:
        path: /etc/ssh/sshd_config
        line: "{{ item }}"
        backup: yes
      loop:
        - 'Ciphers chacha20-poly1305@openssh.com,aes256-gcm@openssh.com,aes128-gcm@openssh.com,aes256-ctr,aes192-ctr,aes128-ctr'
        - 'MACs hmac-sha2-256-etm@openssh.com,hmac-sha2-512-etm@openssh.com,umac-128-etm@openssh.com,hmac-sha2-256,hmac-sha2-512,umac-128@openssh.com'
        - 'KexAlgorithms curve25519-sha256@libssh.org,diffie-hellman-group18-sha512,diffie-hellman-group16-sha512,diffie-hellman-group14-sha256'
      notify: Restart sshd

    - name: Configure password complexity requirements
      lineinfile:
        path: /etc/security/pwquality.conf
        regexp: "{{ item.regexp }}"
        line: "{{ item.line }}"
        backup: yes
      loop:
        - { regexp: '^minlen', line: 'minlen = 14' }
        - { regexp: '^minclass', line: 'minclass = 4' }
        - { regexp: '^maxrepeat', line: 'maxrepeat = 2' }
        - { regexp: '^dcredit', line: 'dcredit = -1' }
        - { regexp: '^ucredit', line: 'ucredit = -1' }
        - { regexp: '^lcredit', line: 'lcredit = -1' }
        - { regexp: '^ocredit', line: 'ocredit = -1' }

    - name: Configure account lockout policy
      lineinfile:
        path: /etc/security/faillock.conf
        regexp: "{{ item.regexp }}"
        line: "{{ item.line }}"
        create: yes
        mode: '0644'
      loop:
        - { regexp: '^deny', line: 'deny = 5' }
        - { regexp: '^unlock_time', line: 'unlock_time = 900' }
        - { regexp: '^audit', line: 'audit' }

    - name: Configure fail2ban jail.local
      copy:
        content: "{{ fail2ban_jail_config }}"
        dest: /etc/fail2ban/jail.local
        mode: '0644'
        backup: yes
      notify: Restart fail2ban

    - name: Enable and start fail2ban service
      systemd:
        name: fail2ban
        enabled: yes
        state: started

    - name: Configure auditd rules
      copy:
        content: "{{ auditd_rules }}"
        dest: /etc/audit/rules.d/hardening.rules
        mode: '0600'
        backup: yes
      notify: Restart auditd

    - name: Set auditd configuration
      lineinfile:
        path: /etc/audit/auditd.conf
        regexp: "{{ item.regexp }}"
        line: "{{ item.line }}"
        backup: yes
      loop:
        - { regexp: '^max_log_file', line: 'max_log_file = 100' }
        - { regexp: '^max_log_file_action', line: 'max_log_file_action = rotate' }
        - { regexp: '^num_logs', line: 'num_logs = 5' }
        - { regexp: '^space_left_action', line: 'space_left_action = email' }
        - { regexp: '^action_mail_acct', line: 'action_mail_acct = root' }
        - { regexp: '^admin_space_left_action', line: 'admin_space_left_action = halt' }

    - name: Enable and start auditd service
      systemd:
        name: auditd
        enabled: yes
        state: started

    - name: Configure firewall to allow only necessary services
      ansible.posix.firewalld:
        service: "{{ item }}"
        permanent: yes
        state: enabled
        immediate: yes
      loop:
        - ssh
      when: ansible_facts['os_family'] == 'RedHat'

    - name: Set GRUB password timeout
      lineinfile:
        path: /etc/default/grub
        regexp: '^GRUB_TIMEOUT='
        line: 'GRUB_TIMEOUT=5'
        backup: yes
      notify: Regenerate grub config

    - name: Remove unnecessary services
      systemd:
        name: "{{ item }}"
        enabled: no
        state: stopped
      loop:
        - avahi-daemon
        - cups
        - rpcbind
      ignore_errors: yes

  handlers:
    - name: Restart sshd
      systemd:
        name: sshd
        state: restarted

    - name: Restart fail2ban
      systemd:
        name: fail2ban
        state: restarted

    - name: Restart auditd
      systemd:
        name: auditd
        state: restarted

    - name: Regenerate grub config
      command: grub2-mkconfig -o /boot/grub2/grub.cfg
      when: ansible_facts['architecture'] != 'aarch64'
